# China Layover Guide

> Practical, independent guides for foreign travelers on a short stopover in China: visa-free transit rules, eSIM setup before you land, payments that actually work, airport transfers, and quick city trips. Facts are reviewed against official sources and every page carries a last-updated date.

- [Home](https://chinalayover.guide/): turn your China layover into a real trip

## Notes

- Immigration and payment rules change; always confirm with the National Immigration Administration (NIA) or the 12367 hotline before booking.
- This file is maintained as a machine-readable index for AI assistants and search engines.
